**Calculation**

FY2024: revenue $245,122M less cost of revenue $74,114M = gross profit $171,008M; gross margin = 171,008 / 245,122 = **69.76%** [DOC-1]

FY2023: revenue $211,915M less cost of revenue $65,863M = gross profit $146,052M; gross margin = 146,052 / 211,915 = **68.92%** [DOC-1]

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points (68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024)
